header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Shayan Ali Baloch advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Nazeer Ahmed Memon advocate for the respondent No.6.
Mr. Muhammad Sharif Solangi A.A.G a/w District Food Controller,
body: Through the instant petition, the petitioner seeks directions to the official respondents to implement the applicable notified prices of wheat flour within District Mirpurkhas. After notice, comments have been filed by respondent No.5, taken on record wherein it is stated that Deputy Commissioner is authority under the law to fix rates of essential commodities by observing market situation of each commodity and notifying the same for compliance and awareness of the general public. Under these circumstances, the Deputy Commissioner, Mirpurkhas is directed to hear the petitioner and redress his grievance within a period of thirty (30) days.
The petition stands disposed of in the above terms.
